# Third-party assets

MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.22-rc.20250304 (Google, Apache-2.0).
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/v/0.10.22-rc.20250304
Files: vision_bundle.mjs, wasm/*.js, wasm/*.wasm. Original license headers are retained.

Pose Landmarker Lite float16 version 1 (Google MediaPipe model).
Model: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/1/pose_landmarker_lite.task
Model overview and model card: https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker
The model is supplied unchanged for local browser inference. It is not a basketball-specific action classifier or a validated coaching model.
